ns2:section.sectionText: A course built around a weekend field trip to Baraboo, Wisconsin, for ESE majors and professors that investigates the ecology, geology and sustainability of the region. Activities will include tours of forests and wetlands, visits to the Leopold Center and the International Crane Foundation, and a geological hike. Lodging is at Durward's Glen Retreat and Conference Center. The trip takes place Sept 29-Oct 1. Grading will be S/U. Attendance at weekly class meetings before and after the trip required.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Earth Systems, Env, & Society or Earth, Society, & Environment or Earth, Soc, Env Sustainability major(s).
